checks.suite: taskpolicy -c background pnpm vitest run && taskpolicy -c background pnpm build

rules: When src-tauri/ changes, also run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

Run every pnpm check, pnpm vitest and pnpm build command with the `taskpolicy -c background ` prefix the checks above use, including the commands on an Issue's **Gate:** line or in its acceptance criteria; run cargo without that prefix (the sccache server cargo starts would inherit the background priority and slow later builds)

When a fix: squash commit changes app code (src/lib, src/routes, src-tauri/src, src-tauri/build.rs) and the Issue's diff stages nothing under src/tests/, src-tauri/tests/ or e2e/specs/ and adds no #[test]/#[tokio::test]/#[cfg(test)] line, add a 'Test-Exempt: <reason>' trailer saying why no test covers it; the commit-msg hook rejects the commit otherwise (docs/COMMITS.md)

src/tests/lib/architecture/layer-baseline.json and the composition-root list only shrink: when your change makes a baseline line stale, delete that line and lower BASELINE_SIZE in src/tests/lib/architecture/layer-rules.test.ts by one; never add a baseline entry or a root (that needs owner sign-off)
Reviewer: a diff that adds an entry to src/tests/lib/architecture/layer-baseline.json, raises BASELINE_SIZE, or adds a composition root gets CHANGES_REQUESTED

cargo test regenerates the ts-rs bindings in src/lib/contracts/generated (doc comments on #[ts(export)] types become JSDoc): after it, commit any change there in the same Issue, or CI fails its freshness check

Before changing or reviewing a save, index, path-change, watcher, search-index, editor decoration, widget or QueryJS path, read each matching file in the worktree and follow it: docs/agents/indexing-watcher-rules.md, docs/agents/live-preview-rules.md
